title: ci: one setup-workspace composite action replaces the setup steps copied into 38 jobs, and pull requests stop saving the pnpm store
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9HTCCgQfvL4bghGe5pCNu1u)_
Fixes #26083

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新建 `.github/actions/setup-workspace` 组合 action（Node 读 .nvmrc、pnpm、store 缓存、`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`），38 个 job 手抄的 setup 串换成它一步；只装 Node 的 job 改读 .nvmrc。
- 为什么改：同一串五步手抄在约 40 个 job 里，改一次要改 40 处；pnpm store 缓存在 pull_request 上也会存，挤占 10 GB 缓存池、把 main 的 Turbo 种子挤掉。现在只有 push 和 schedule 存。
- 风险与回滚：纯 CI 配置，不发布任何包；出问题整 PR revert 即可。风险在 store 改为 push/schedule 才存后，PR 首跑可能更常冷装（读 main 的 store 不受影响）。
- 先看：`.github/actions/setup-workspace/action.yml`（保存条件那一步）、`.github/workflows/release.yml` 的 publish job（组合 action 放在 Guard 之后）、`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的 ui-deps 保存条件。
- 两分钟验证：在本 PR 的 CI 任一 job 日志里展开 "Setup workspace"，应看到 "Save pnpm store" 被跳过；`grep -c "node-version: '22'" .github/workflows/*.yml` 只剩 scaffold-e2e.yml 一处。
- 需要你做的：受管面（`.github/workflows/**`），请 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 审批后由席位落地。

## What changes

- **New composite `.github/actions/setup-workspace/action.yml`.** `actions/setup-node` with `node-version-file: .nvmrc` (and `package-manager-cache: false`, since pnpm is not on PATH yet), then `./.github/actions/setup-pnpm` as a step, `pnpm store path`, `actions/cache/restore` on the one store key, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, and `actions/cache/save` only when `github.event_name` is `push` or `schedule` and the exact key missed (`continue-on-error: true`). Inputs: `install: 'false'` (Node and pnpm only, for the jobs that run pnpm but install nothing), `install-args` (validate-deps keeps `--prefer-offline`), `save-store: 'false'` (the jobs that were deliberately restore-only stay so).
- **38 jobs call it** in place of the hand-copied steps, `showcase-smoke.yml` included: its `pnpm/action-setup` and setup-node `cache: pnpm` are gone, so the acquisition census now reads 0 uncached sites. In release.yml's `publish` job the composite sits where `Setup pnpm` was, after the Guard step, so nothing is installed before the Guard has passed; that job keeps its own setup-node step (now `.nvmrc`).
- **Jobs that need Node and nothing else** keep their own setup-node step, now `node-version-file: .nvmrc`.
- **Kept spelled out, each with its reason written beside it:**
  - ci.yml's five ui jobs (`ui-deps`, `type-check-ui`, `test-ui`, `lint-ui`, `build-e2e-ui`). Pins under `ui/scripts/__tests__/` read those steps by text and by name (see Acceptance notes); this PR does not touch `ui/**`. They switch to `node-version-file: .nvmrc`, and `ui-deps`' `Save pnpm cache` now also requires `push` or `schedule`.
  - governed-surface-guard.yml: every toolchain step is gated on the toolchain question and degrades on its own, pinned one by one by `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`. Its store step becomes `actions/cache/restore` (the workflow runs on `pull_request` and `merge_group` only, so it never saves now), and its Node pin reads `.nvmrc`.
  - release.yml `release-integrity`: installs the version commit's tree, not the checkout.
  - scaffold-e2e.yml `registry-canary`: checks nothing out, so there is no `.nvmrc` to read; the one literal `node-version: '22'` left, still held to `.nvmrc` by `check:node-version`.
- **setup-pnpm is not retired**: it becomes a step of the composite, because the ui pins and the two jobs above still call it by path.
- **Gates that read these steps by text**: `scripts/check-pnpm-acquisition.mjs` recognises `uses: ./.github/actions/setup-workspace` as a cached mechanism (MECHANISMS row, header spelling list, two new self-test cases: recognised, and late acquisition still fails; battery floor 12 to 14). `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`'s install-chain pin matches `actions/cache/restore@` as well as `actions/cache@`. No other behaviour changes in either.
- `.github/dependabot.yml`: the github-actions entry reads `directories: ["/", "/.github/actions/*"]`.
- TURBO_* env lines are unchanged and stay per step: hoisting them to job level would hand `TURBO_TOKEN` to every step of the job. `fetch-depth`, the Turbo seed keys, the Next.js cache and every job name are unchanged.

## Tests

The diff edits two gate scripts, so each one's own self-test ran, plus the derived family list (Verification).

- `node scripts/check-pnpm-acquisition.mjs --self-test`: `14 cases pass`; `pnpm check:pnpm-acquisition`: `OK`, census `45 acquisition site(s), 0 of them uncached` (38 workspace, 7 setup-pnpm, 0 action-setup).
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`: `393 cases pass`, exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

Counts re-taken on `origin/main` at c51aed4f before the edit and on this head after (`.github/workflows/*.yml`):

| reading | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `node-version: '22'` | 60 (59 steps + 1 comment) | 2 (registry-canary + the same comment in half-state-patrol.yml) |
| store key `pnpm-store-v3-${{ hashFiles(...) }}` | 40 | 7 (the ui jobs' 6 + governed-surface-guard), plus the composite's restore/save pair |
| `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` | 43 lines | 7 (5 ui jobs, governed-surface-guard, release-integrity's version-tree script), plus the composite |
| `uses: ./.github/actions/setup-workspace` | 0 | 38 |

The ui pins that hold the five ui jobs' steps in place (for the ui lane to move onto the composite later; none edited here):

- `ui/scripts/__tests__/ci-setup-pnpm-wiring.test.ts`: each ui job must contain the text `uses: ./.github/actions/setup-pnpm` before its first pnpm.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts`: `ui-deps` saves the store through its own bounded `actions/cache/save` step paired with a restore that has an `id`.
- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` located by text in the job block: `check-action-forward-parity`, `check-i18n-call-site-keys`, `check-i18n-designer-table-parity`, `check-i18n-en-drift`, `check-package-self-import`, `check-phantom-dependencies`, `check-unreferenced-sources`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape` (all `ui/scripts/__tests__/*.test.ts`).

The second Acceptance item (no `pnpm-store-*` save on a `pull_request` run) is read from this PR's own CI run and reported on the card.

## Verification

Gate families derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at the head below, each exit captured before any pipe, reconciled with `--ran`.

Head `2cb5ee1f`, merge base `c51aed4f`.

- `dispatch-gates --ran`: `94 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 94 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 94 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`. All 94 exit 0.
- Four families first answered exit 3 (no built packages in a fresh container: `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`) and `check:type-check-debt` hit the loop's 300 s cap while it built. After `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'` under `os-verify-lock.sh` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, 75/75 tasks) all five re-ran to exit 0.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`: `1901 cases pass` (fast tier), exit 0.
- `pnpm check:node-version`: `OK (23 setup-node step(s) across 39 workflow(s) and 3 composite action(s), all on Node 22)`.
- Not derived, run because the diff edits root `ci.yml`'s ui jobs: every `ui/scripts/__tests__/*.test.ts` that reads the root workflows (41 files, `vitest run --project unit`): `Test Files 41 passed (41)`, `Tests 1284 passed (1284)`.
- Not run locally: the repo-wide scans CI owns (`pnpm lint` and the rest of `Lint & Repo Gates`); this PR's check-runs are their reading.
